blocks_9: Narrow layouts truncate participant identity and squeeze reading space; the narrow Calls page also removes the visible video action.
Thread-card separation is weak, while small utility typography and strongly outlined reactions make the reading hierarchy uneven.
Vertical spacing is inconsistent: meeting history leaves large empty gaps, settings rows use different rhythms, and authentication footers jump between states.
Extreme-aspect attachment thumbnails are hard to inspect and the long-draft state has no visible expansion affordance.
Selected preview controls and explanatory copy do not yet have the same clarity as the strongest dialogs.

issues: Utility labels are small; presence rows have a tight 30 px rhythm.
Meeting detail has weak differentiation between metadata and invitation; long explanatory copy competes with the sparse meeting content.
Large gap between meeting header and the beginning-of-conversation marker; utility text is small.
About 170 px of empty vertical space above the history marker wastes meeting-chat height.
Reaction pill and toolbar borders are stronger than the surrounding message grouping.
Explanatory prose and capability notes occupy more visual attention than the recent-person actions.
Secondary actions are small outline icons.
Video-call actions disappear from the people rows at this width.
The explanatory paragraph wraps to four lines and dominates the task area.
Thread-card outlines provide weak separation, especially in dark mode.
Nested reply timestamps and action labels are small.
Sidebar takes 296 of 760 px; post content is squeezed into short lines.
Thread-card outlines are faint in both themes.
Composer context nearly fills its available text width.
The no-results explanation uses small secondary text; the open conversation remains much more visually dominant.
Small secondary instruction text and persistent sidebar truncation are the remaining polish issues.
Sidebar previews truncate extensively.
Small metadata and strongly outlined reaction pills make the hierarchy slightly busy.
Several person names and most message previews truncate while the sidebar still consumes 39% of the window.
The composer loses its mention hint.
The capped reading column is sensible, but small metadata remains visually slight at this window size.
Reaction borders are disproportionately prominent.
Extreme-aspect images become roughly 10 px strips inside 144 x 96 px cards, making content difficult to inspect.
The remove controls are visually tiny.
The draft shows only lines 111 through 119 with a small internal scrollbar and no visible expand affordance.
Dense draft text and send controls share the same lower edge.
Attachment size and popup keyboard hint are small.
The suggestion popup obscures the latest message context, though it remains clearly attached to the composer.
Failure is clearly persistent and retryable, but the important explanation is compressed into one small utility line.
Clear loading state; small supporting text is the main visual limitation.
Good mention emphasis and theme parity; utility text and reaction outlines still compete with the restrained message styling.
Fit selection is communicated with a weak grey fill instead of the clearer selected-control treatment used elsewhere.
Controls and dimensions are small relative to the very large preview surface.
QR is legible and well isolated; the instruction is fairly small and the copy action is visually detached at the bottom right.
Good grouping and clear primary action; email addresses and keyboard hints are small.
Clear purpose and action hierarchy; permission detail is small and relatively dense.
Readable search structure; repeated long truncated snippets and small bottom guidance make scanning slightly laborious.
Uneven vertical rhythm across checkbox rows and their helper text.
Small section labels and hints make the dialog feel denser than its overall whitespace warrants.
The first-run card contains many similarly weighted instructional lines.
Important tenant guidance is small; technical field labels need more visual hierarchy.
Clear columns; the 191 px key column in the left half creates long jumps between short shortcuts and their meanings.
Keycap labels are small.
Clear primary action and calm composition; small secondary controls and a prominent two-line legal footer limit polish.
Clear waiting and recovery actions; the legal footer shifts upward compared with the initial sign-in screen.
Strong code hierarchy; small waiting text and three equally sized compact action buttons slightly crowd the lower card.
Clear recovery and account identity; secondary account and app-registration text are small.
Failure and recovery are clear; the footer and card bottom shift noticeably between authentication states.
The short card and legal footer move upward substantially compared with other sign-in states, leaving a very empty lower canvas.
Clear compact dialog; small field label and compact controls are the remaining limitations.
Calm empty state; channel names and guidance are small compared with the available space.

top_issues.issue: The narrow layout preserves too much sidebar width and sacrifices identification and message space.
top_issues.evidence: The sidebar boundary is x=296 in a 760 px window, 38.9% of its width. Katherine Johnson, Grace Hopper and Margaret Hamilton truncate; channel text begins around x=369.
top_issues.fix: Below 800 px, reduce the rail plus list to 248-264 px, use 32 px list avatars, and preserve a 160 px name lane before timestamps. Allow a collapsed list while reading.

top_issues.issue: Narrow calls rows lose the visible video-call action without a replacement affordance.
top_issues.evidence: At 1280 px each person has phone and video icons around x=295 and x=333. At 760 px each row shows only a phone around x=268; no overflow is visible.
top_issues.fix: Reserve a 56 px two-icon action lane or replace the action lane with a visible menu containing both call choices.

top_issues.issue: Thread containers have weak edge separation, making distinct posts and nested replies harder to parse.
top_issues.evidence: Pillow samples: light outline #b9bcc4 on #ffffff = 1.90:1; dark outline #4d4f58 on card #26272c = 1.83:1 and on canvas #1a1b1f = 2.11:1. These are grouping outlines, so this alone does not establish an interactive-component WCAG failure.
top_issues.fix: Use #858994 in light and #747884 in dark for thread outlines if the boundary carries grouping, with 16 px between cards and a restrained reply divider.

top_issues.issue: Too much useful information lives at the smallest utility sizes.
top_issues.evidence: Timestamp glyphs occupy about 9-10 raster pixels vertically; rail labels about 9 px; attachment-size text about 8 px. Body text occupies about 14 px with about 20 px line spacing. Exact font point sizes cannot be recovered from pixels alone.
top_issues.fix: Use 13 pt for timestamps, helper text, email addresses and attachment metadata, with 18 pt line height; retain 11 pt only for nonessential overlines. Keep message body at 14-15 pt / 20-22 pt.

top_issues.issue: Meeting history wastes substantial vertical space above its first content.
top_issues.evidence: In call-docked the header ends at y=132 and the history marker sits around y=307, leaving about 170 px before the marker. In call-bar the marker is around y=247.
top_issues.fix: Use 32-48 px top padding before the history marker; retain bottom anchoring for recent activity but cap empty top padding so useful history can fill the panel.

top_issues.issue: Extreme-aspect image previews are technically contained but visually uninformative.
top_issues.evidence: The 3072 x 256 and 256 x 3072 attachments occupy 144 x 96 px tiles, producing content strips roughly 12 px high and 8 px wide. Each remove circle is about 22 px.
top_issues.fix: Use a cropped detail thumbnail for aspect ratios beyond 4:1, retain the dimension caption, and offer a clearly visible full-preview action. Increase the remove hit area to at least 24 x 24 px.

top_issues.issue: Checkbox spacing mixes two rhythms and weakens grouping.
top_issues.evidence: Notification checkbox baseline is near y=357 with helper text y=386; the next row is y=422, then rows around y=456 and y=490. The first row-to-row interval is about 65 px versus 34 px thereafter.
top_issues.fix: Use 36 px rows, 4 px between a label and helper, and 16 px after the full helper block. Give section headers 24 px top and 8 px bottom spacing.

top_issues.issue: A long draft offers little visible orientation or room to inspect the full composition.
top_issues.evidence: The composer spans y=552-760, shows about nine lines from column_111 through column_119, and has a narrow scrollbar at x=1168; no expansion control is visible.
top_issues.fix: Add a small expand action to open a larger drafting surface; keep the compact composer capped near 200 px and separate its action lane from draft text by 12 px.

top_issues.issue: Selected zoom mode is weaker than selected controls elsewhere.
top_issues.evidence: Fit uses #e2e3e8 against white in light, only 1.28:1 fill contrast; dark uses #34353c against #26272c, 1.22:1. Settings instead uses a distinct orange selected appearance. Text itself remains readable.
top_issues.fix: Use the existing orange selected fill with contrasting text for Fit, or add a 2 px accent underline and semibold label. Maintain the 3:1 control-outline target.

top_issues.issue: Authentication state changes shift the lower layout excessively.
top_issues.evidence: The card begins at y=217 across these states, but ends around y=460 for signin, y=418 for signin-browser, y=490 for device-code and y=343 for finishing. The legal footer consequently moves from about y=555 to y=400.
top_issues.fix: Reserve a consistent 280 px authentication card body and place the legal footer on a stable baseline below it, around y=560; vary content inside the reserved space.

top_issues.issue: Long explanatory copy competes with the task instead of forming a clear secondary layer.
top_issues.evidence: Calls-narrow has four lines of explanation around y=235-300 followed by two capability rows; setup has three introductory lines plus labels, tenant guidance, save guidance and a two-line footer.
top_issues.fix: Keep one 14 pt instruction sentence near the task, move secondary explanation into the existing Details/Advanced disclosure, and use 16 px separation between instructions and actions.

top_issues.issue: Reaction pills have stronger visual edges than their supporting role warrants.
top_issues.evidence: Selected reaction outlines are about 2 px and visibly darker/lighter than the faint card grouping elsewhere; pills are roughly 28 px high for a 12-13 px emoji/count label.
top_issues.fix: Use a 1 px outline with at least 3:1 contrast, 24-26 px pill height and 8 px horizontal padding; reserve the accent fill or stronger outline for the person’s own selected reaction.
